why: Near miss: the learner opened Shift+A > Light and is hovering the list (Point, Sun, Spot, Area). No light was added: the outliner still shows only Camera, Light (the default point light) and Mug. The word Area is on screen only as a menu item.

step.title: Light it and aim the camera
step.instructions: Add an area light (Shift+A > Light > Area), raise its power to 500 W and aim it at the mug.
